title: Add expiring stock reservations
prompt: The inventory module in this project tracks stock per SKU. Add reservations as described in README.md: `reserve`, `release`, `commit`, `available`, `reservedQty`, expiry through an injectable clock, and make `remove` respect reserved stock. Existing `add`, `remove` and `onHand` behaviour must stay the same when nothing is reserved. Run the tests with `npm test`.
